recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7278 unless a separate substantive tracker reopens the HTTP/Bundle ETag guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-7278 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction for the FHIR-core HTTP page. It requested fixing the grammar in the Managing Resource Contention sentence that originally said bundle resources have no ETag and the versionId of the resources is used directly.
initial_application: The issue was applied by SVN revision 5383, represented in Git as da3674c5a902b653c08fc425ba98aa68d60016b9 with subject '#7278 - typo'. That commit changed source/http.html from 'versionId of the resources is used directly' to 'versionId of the resource is used directly.'
additional_context: The current source/http.html still contains the corrected singular wording at the RESTful API Managing Resource Contention section. source/documentation.html links http.html as the RESTful API (HTTP) page, confirming the inspected page remains part of the current core specification surface. Confluence refs and exact FHIR-7278 Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion, and the broader Jira phrase search found no tightly connected later issue that changes this typo-only decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty audit commit because the current source already reflects the historical application, and changing to the Jira proposal's plural 'resources are' would be unnecessary and less faithful to the applied source change.
